name: ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case
title: ColorFittings Carbon Fiber Display Case
description:
Showcase the Original Colored AN Fittings with the official ColorFittings 7-Color Display Case. Designed for dealers, vendors, and performance shops, this premium shadow box features all seven of our signature anodized colors mounted against a high-gloss carbon fiber backing for a clean, motorsport-inspired presentation.
Each display is professionally assembled to highlight the depth, finish, and precision machining of our CNC 6061-T6 billet aluminum fittings. The carbon fiber background enhances contrast and makes each color pop, creating an eye-catching retail or showroom centerpiece that instantly communicates quality and performance.
Perfect for:


 	
Performance shops and speed stores

 	
Automotive dealerships

 	
Race teams and fabrication shops

 	
Trade show booths and vendor displays

 	
Garage or showroom wall décor


Built to elevate your retail presence, this ColorFittings shadow box display helps customers see and compare all seven anodized color options in person — making purchase decisions easier and increasing upsell opportunities.
Complete your display setup with our full line of AN fittings, braided hose, and assembly tools to bring the full ColorFittings experience to your customers.
